WITH route AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-117.769801 44.550957, -117.769609 44.551277, -117.769481 44.551323, -117.769353 44.551369, -117.768682 44.551186, -117.768427 44.550454, -117.768332 44.549287, -117.767693 44.548052, -117.767502 44.547321, -117.767406 44.547252, -117.767406 44.546978, -117.767215 44.546566, -117.767247 44.545994, -117.767599 44.545423, -117.767696 44.5446, -117.767568 44.544348, -117.766865 44.543799, -117.766641 44.543753, -117.765842 44.543227, -117.765715 44.542953, -117.765587 44.541695, -117.76562 44.54094, -117.765908 44.540392, -117.765844 44.539889, -117.764918 44.538768, -117.764311 44.537716, -117.764088 44.537533, -117.763673 44.536755, -117.763705 44.536069)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg
  FROM route r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.seg_len_m,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p1) AS z1,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p2) AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip dc
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM slopes
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DEGREES(ATAN(g)) AS slope_degrees
FROM avg_grade;
